note: Shared by the Python tests (test_access_eval.py) and, later, the clients. A profile given as a string ('base.operator') is a base profile of access_base. A request has operation and an optional target; context has args, mode, modes (of the person), job_running, machine_on, via. expect lists the fields of the decision that must be equal (allowed, code, profile, id, needed_tier, failed_conditions). documents: a profile document and the ProfileError code expected (null = valid). store: the text of a workshop-access.json (null = no file) and whether it is damaged. A request may carry args instead of target: the target is then the one the call declares (access_targets.target_of), as the service derives it.
